$comment: Italy's pilot outlines (decision #62), read by Tools/data/build_it_areas.py. 'piemonte': the region's official DOC/DOCG area by its 'codice' (Regione Piemonte, aree di produzione vini DOC e DOCG, CC BY 4.0). 'istat': the municipalities the spec names, ISTAT generalised limits at 1 Jan 2025; 'partial' municipalities are taken whole, so the outline is approximate and larger than the real area. 'renamed': names in the spec that ISTAT now holds under a merged municipality.

alto-adige.source: MASAF disciplinare Alto Adige o dell'Alto Adige, art. 3
alto-adige.notes: Art. 3.1: 'territorio viticolo' of the a) list, so all partial except Laives (whole per Colli di Bolzano 3.2). Sub-zones Colli di Bolzano, Meranese, Santa Maddalena, Terlano, Valle Isarco, Valle Venosta lie inside this union.

trentino.notes: Trentino and Trentino Superiore zone. Partial = limited to named cadastral comuni (Altavalle: Faver, Grumes, Valda; Vigolana: Bosentino, Vigolo Vattaro; Borgo Chiese: Cimego I and II, Condino; Comano Terme: ex Bleggio Inferiore (Bleggio superiore also named); Lona-Lases; San Lorenzo Dorsino: ex Dorsino). Vino Santo and Marzemino sub-lists are subsets. UNMATCHED: Faedo

collio.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare Collio Goriziano o Collio, art. 3
collio.notes: rulebook draws the zone along roads and streams; no municipality list

friuli-colli-orientali.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare Friuli Colli Orientali, art. 3
friuli-colli-orientali.notes: rulebook draws the zone along roads and streams; no municipality list

friuli-grave.notes: Whole and partial communes in provinces of Udine and Pordenone; the rest of the text is a boundary description. Gorizia and Trieste not included. Text: 'Friuli' Grave.

valpolicella.notes: Text: 'in tutto o in parte' for 19 communes in province of Verona, so all partial. Classico: Negrar, Marano, Fumane, Sant'Ambrogio, San Pietro in Cariano. Valpantena sub-zone (Grezzana, Verona) is inside. Amarone, Recioto, Ripasso have own rulebooks.

soave.notes: Text: 'in tutto o in parte' for 13 communes in province of Verona, so all partial. Classico zone: part of Soave and Monteforte d'Alpone only. Colli Scaligeri sub-zone and Recioto/Superiore use sub-areas of the same zone.

chianti.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare Chianti, art. 3
chianti.notes: rulebook draws the zone along roads and streams; no municipality list

bolgheri.notes: Excludes territory west of the old Aurelia (SS1) route. No sub-zones (Superiore uses same zone).

brunello-di-montalcino.source: MASAF disciplinare Brunello di Montalcino, art. 3
brunello-di-montalcino.notes: Whole commune of Montalcino as delimited on 30 Nov 2011.

vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.source: MASAF disciplinare Vino Nobile di Montepulciano, art. 3
vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.notes: Only part of Montepulciano (two boundary-described areas, incl. frazione Valiano); no other commune.

verdicchio-dei-castelli-di-jesi.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi, art. 3
verdicchio-dei-castelli-di-jesi.notes: rulebook draws the zone along roads and streams; no municipality list

orvieto.notes: Text: 'in tutto o in parte' for all 18 communes, so all partial (whole/part not stated per commune). 13 in province of Terni, 5 in Viterbo (Castiglione in Teverina, Civitella d'Agliano, Graffignano, Lubriano, Bagnoregio). Classico zone is a boundary-described older area (DM 23 Oct 1931), communes not named.

frascati.notes: Whole: Frascati, Grottaferrata, Monte Porzio Catone; part of Roma and Montecompatri. Superiore/Cannellino use same zone.

montepulciano-d-abruzzo.notes: Whole communes in provinces of Chieti, L'Aquila, Pescara, Teramo. Text names 'Tossicia e Isola del Gran Sasso' (Isola del Gran Sasso d'Italia). Colline Teramane DOCG and Terre dei Vestini, Casauria, Alto Tirino sub-zones are inside; not separately listed.

taurasi.notes: All in province of Avellino, whole communes.

fiano-di-avellino.source: MASAF disciplinare Fiano di Avellino, art. 3

greco-di-tufo.source: MASAF disciplinare Greco di Tufo, art. 3

salice-salentino.notes: Text spells San Donaci as Sandonaci. Part of Campi Salentina and Cellino San Marco.

aglianico-del-vulture.source: MASAF disciplinare Aglianico del Vulture, art. 3
aglianico-del-vulture.notes: Whole communes except Atella, which excludes the three administrative islands Sant'Ilario, Riparossa and Macchia.

etna.notes: All parts of 20 communes in province of Catania (altitude-bounded, 400-1000 m). Text abbreviates names; prefix-matched to ISTAT.

prosecco.notes: Whole provinces: Belluno, Gorizia, Padova, Pordenone, Treviso, Trieste, Udine, Venezia, Vicenza (Veneto and Friuli Venezia Giulia). Denominazione covers the sparkling and still DOC; Conegliano Valdobbiadene and Asolo DOCG zones lie inside.

conegliano-valdobbiadene.source: MASAF disciplinare Conegliano Valdobbiadene - Prosecco, art. 3
conegliano-valdobbiadene.notes: Text: 'territorio collinare' of 15 communes, so all partial. Sub-zones Rive and Superiore di Cartizze (in Valdobbiadene) are inside; not separately listed.

canelli.source: EU register PDO-IT-02810 (no summary sheet in the register)

nizza.source: EU register PDO-IT-01896 (no summary sheet in the register)

carmignano.notes: only terreni collinari of both comuni

elba-aleatico-passito.notes: text says only 'comuni dell isola d'Elba', none named; the seven Elba comuni are my inference from the island [R]; Rio = merged Rio nell'Elba + Rio Marina [R]

bagnoli-friularo.notes: Classico sub-zone = all of Bagnoli di Sopra

scanzo.notes: hill part only, street boundary; flat land excluded

sforzato-di-valtellina.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare sforzato-di-valtellina, art. 3
sforzato-di-valtellina.notes: rulebook draws the zone along a boundary; its municipality list is incomplete or absent (#71)

conero.notes: Loreto, Recanati only appear as boundary; not included

recioto-di-gambellara.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare recioto-di-gambellara, art. 3
recioto-di-gambellara.notes: rulebook draws the zone along a boundary; its municipality list is incomplete or absent (#71)

primitivo-di-manduria-dolce-naturale.notes: intro says 'tutto o parte' but list reads 'i territori dei comuni': treated whole; Taranto only frazione Talsano + administrative islands inside Fragagnano and Lizzano

castel-del-monte-nero-di-troia-riserva.notes: Binetto: only administrative island D'Ameli (counted partial); Canosa di Puglia, Grumo only boundary, not included

castel-del-monte-rosso-riserva.notes: Binetto: only administrative island D'Ameli (counted partial); Canosa di Puglia, Grumo only boundary, not included

castel-del-monte-bombino-nero.notes: Binetto: only administrative island D'Ameli (counted partial); Canosa di Puglia, Grumo only boundary, not included

ramandolo.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare ramandolo, art. 3
ramandolo.notes: rulebook draws the zone along a boundary; its municipality list is incomplete or absent (#71)

oltrepo-pavese-metodo-classico.notes: Canevino and Ruino now merged into Colli Verdi [R]; Godiasco, Rivanazzano renamed with Terme (in comuni.csv); hill belt of Oltrepo; San Ponzo Semola (frazione of Ponte Nizza) mentioned, not a comune

rosazzo.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare rosazzo, art. 3
rosazzo.notes: rulebook draws the zone along a boundary; its municipality list is incomplete or absent (#71)

morellino-di-scansano.notes: hill belt between Ombrone and Albegna

colli-orientali-del-friuli-picolit.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare colli-orientali-del-friuli-picolit, art. 3
colli-orientali-del-friuli-picolit.notes: rulebook draws the zone along a boundary; its municipality list is incomplete or absent (#71)

montello-rosso.notes: Crespano del Grappa + Paderno del Grappa merged into Pieve del Grappa 2019 [R]

asolo-prosecco.notes: same zone as Montello Rosso (identical list); Crespano del Grappa + Paderno del Grappa merged into Pieve del Grappa 2019 [R]

colline-teramane-montepulciano-dabruzzo.notes: text lists comuni then draws a boundary that excludes the west of the province; whole/partial not stated, so all partial; 'Celino Attanasio' is a typo in the text

montecucco-sangiovese.notes: terreni vocati within listed comuni plus boundary; all partial

partial: Castrocaro Terme e Terra del Sole
romagna-albana.notes: 'in tutto o in parte': all partial; lower limit on valley side (SS 9 Emilia, railway) for Savignano, Cesena, Forlimpopoli, Forli, Faenza, Castelbolognese, Imola, Ozzano

franciacorta.notes: Cologne, Coccaglio, Rovato, Cazzago only north of ex SS 573 and SS 11; text also excludes one area in the west (not parsed)

casauria.notes: all Pescara province; Popoli renamed Popoli Terme (in comuni.csv) [R]

bardolino-superiore.notes: 'in tutto o in parte': all partial; short names expanded by me from province Verona (Castelnuovo, Peschiera, Valeggio, Cavaion, Caprino, Costermano) [R]

colli-bolognesi-pignoletto.notes: Savignano sul Panaro is in Modena province

colli-di-conegliano.notes: 'in tutto o in parte': all partial; zone A (bianco, rosso), later zones B/C (Refrontolo passito, Torchiato di Fregona) in the file not read

montefalco-sagrantino.notes: Montefalco: terreni vocati within entire comune, counted whole

cerasuolo-di-vittoria.notes: Ragusa, Caltanissetta (Niscemi, Gela, Riesi, Butera, Mazzarino) and Catania (Caltagirone, Licodia Eubea, Mazzarrone) provinces; Mazzarrone is a newer comune split from Caltagirone

piave-malanotte.notes: Treviso and Venezia provinces; "bacino del Piave" excluding unsuitable areas

lison.notes: Santo Stino di Livenza = San Stino di Livenza in ISTAT 2025 (renamed); Classico sub-zone (art. 3 B): frazioni Lison, Pradipozzo, Summaga (Portogruaro), Belfiore, Blessaglia, Salvarolo (Pramaggiore), more not read

valtellina-superiore.source: Candiago et al. 2022 (CC0), traced from MASAF disciplinare valtellina-superiore, art. 3
valtellina-superiore.notes: rulebook draws the zone along a boundary; its municipality list is incomplete or absent (#71)
